---
title: "What changed"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
ends <- read_csv("unemployment.csv") |>
  filter(region != "Kingdom",
         date %in% range(date)) |>
  group_by(region) |>
  mutate(rose = last(rate) > first(rate)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(rose)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5.5
ggplot(ends, aes(quarter, rate, group = region,
                 colour = rose)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#00803A",
                                 `FALSE` = "grey75"),
                      guide = "none")
```
